download_bb3_3B_model: download the BB3 3B model to the specified datapath directory using the Parlai zoo module
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the BB3 3B model.tgz file if not already built
check_model_built: check if the BB3 3B model is already built before downloading using the built function
get_model_directory: get the model directory path for the BB3 3B model using get_model_dir
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that handles BB3 3B model downloads with version checking
